zh: 第一次打开看板时不再把全部组件按字母序铺满一页：现在是两块看板，「我的看板」是精选的一屏（题头、天气、番茄钟、待办、日程、翻面组、改动对比、余额、时钟、活动热力图），「组件画廊」按数据展示、工具、动效模板把每个内置组件各放一张；画廊里的表格与键值写入了正常的示例内容。看板页的标签条在滚动时有了一条垫底，底部的加号后面也有一条渐隐底，不再压在卡片边缘；切到较矮的看板时底部不再有一段空白的滚动区域。已有看板的用户不受影响。
en: A first launch no longer pours every widget onto one page in alphabetical order. It now creates two boards: "My board", a curated first screen (hero, weather, pomodoro, to-do, calendar, flip group, diff, balance, clock, activity heatmap), and "Widget gallery", one card per built-in widget grouped into data display, tools and motion templates, with sensible sample content in its table and key-value cards. The tab strip now has a backing while the board scrolls, the add button sits on a fading base instead of on top of card edges, and switching to a shorter board no longer leaves blank scroll space at the bottom. Existing boards are untouched.
